sources.title: Spokane River Water Trail — Launches
observations: Lists Mission Ave. in the State Line to Upriver Dam reach for canoe/kayak/SUP only; marks it Whitewater Park & Play only.
Does not list Mission Ave. for rafts, drift boats, or powerboats.
sources.use: Primary local water-trail confirmation of intended access type and its limitation.

sources.title: Spokane River Water Trail — Mission Ave. map detail record
observations: The page retrieves its public map locations from the water trail's linked SRF Watertrail spreadsheet; record ID 4001 is Mission Ave.
The record publishes location 47.671585,-117.180981, river mile 88.5, year-round season, daylight-only hours, Whitewater Area yes, and Canoe and Kayak yes.
The published map coordinate exactly matches the stored endpoint. The record is a site point and does not label a surveyed water-entry toe.
sources.use: Coordinate and public-site confirmation for the access-area anchor.

sources.title: Avista Spokane River Project Recreation Monitoring Report — Sullivan Hole / Mission Avenue
observations: Identifies Sullivan Hole — End of Mission Avenue as trail access on the east side of the river in Spokane County.
Reports the access point at approximately 47 degrees 40.29 minutes north, 117 degrees 10.84 minutes west, within about 60 feet of the water-trail record coordinate.
Lists 30 vehicle-only spaces and no vehicle-with-trailer parking; this corroborates local access identity but is an older 2010 recreation inventory and is not used as current launch-toe evidence.
sources.use: Secondary location and access-area corroboration; not the current controlling source for access type or precise coordinates.
